notes.title: In Retrospect Official Soundtrack now available!
notes.content:
The OST for In Retrospect is finally here!  

Created by Paper Salamander, who was once referred to as "sophisticated nerdcore", the In Retrospect OST blends pop, punk, piano and chiptunes over a unique and varied 24 tracks! 

Stream or download it now for FREE!

Spotify (streaming): https://open.spotify.com/album/2etYjXwvCzh3YyCv2jN6UE

YouTube (streaming): https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLxsWp9xSCVJZzpljHtpNa_GEPMyw231qT

Bandcamp (download): https://papersalamander.bandcamp.com/album/in-retrospect-original-game-soundtrack

notes.title: Just a quick update for everyone following In Retrospect on Steam
notes.content:
Hey all!  Sorry that I haven't been updating here, I tend to do my updates on the In Retrospect website and social media, but I'm going to try to make sure I hit Steam with all updates now as well.  With that said, I recently posted a big update on my blog: [url=https://www.inretrospectgame.com/blog/]Looking Back at 2021… In Retrospect![/url]

If you have been following In Retrospect on Steam, you have probably noticed the release date keeps getting pushed back.  Long story short, the game IS coming soon.  I'm almost finished!  It's hard to give an exact release date yet, but I'm hoping to have the game out by this Spring.  Possibly a bit sooner, possibly a bit later.  We shall see.

The other new thing is I have a Discord now!  [url=https://discord.gg/YAuM7hYws9]Join up and come say hello![/url]

In fact, here is a list of various sites and social media accounts for Paper Salamander / In Retrospect that you can follow if you are so inclined.

[url=http://inretrospectgame.com]In Retrospect website[/url]
[url=https://discord.gg/YAuM7hYws9]Discord[/url]
[url=https://twitter.com/papersalamander]Twitter[/url]
[url=https://facebook.com/papersalamander]Facebook[/url]
[url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCvBabJFnSFEwkvIZKAnio5A/videos]YouTube[/url]


More coming soon!
